purpose: Resolve the exact-computation gap in WP6-DZ-FEAS-v2 by deciding the same 11,700 saturated coefficient ideals with localization-equivalent preprocessing, lazy residual construction, and dual exact Groebner algorithms.
claim_boundary: A QUALIFIED_WITNESS certifies only one W1-W12 algebraic phase curve and is not a differential-Galois obstruction. A COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT exhausts only the frozen 11,700 graph ideals and does not prove that no suitable orbit exists.

target_model.system: The v2 arbitrary-positive-mass Newtonian rectilinear flow in one ordered collision-free chamber after translation reduction.
target_model.physical_dense_open: r!=0, x!=0, x!=1, every declared cover denominator is nonzero, z is in the declared Laurent chart, and every exact-support coefficient is nonzero.
target_model.scope_identity: The v3 model, covers, supports, mass sentinels, residual identities, saturation, coefficient field, and enumeration must be byte-derived from or exactly equal to the frozen v2 definitions.

witness_requirements.W1: The candidate solves the full planar Newtonian three-body equations exactly on a nonempty open part of its phase curve.
witness_requirements.W2: The candidate is valid for arbitrary finite positive masses or belongs to a finite set of branches proved exhaustive over that mass domain.
witness_requirements.W3: The candidate is nonstationary and is not merely a known homothetic central-configuration solution.
witness_requirements.W4: The candidate satisfies H=0 and C=0 identically by exact symbolic calculation.
witness_requirements.W5: The orbit is an algebraic phase curve over an explicitly declared differential base field.
witness_requirements.W6: The algebraic-distance variables and every denominator are valid on a nonempty dense open subset of the phase curve.
witness_requirements.W7: The gradients of H and C are independent at a generic point of the candidate.
witness_requirements.W8: An exact tangent common-level VE can be derived and the flow, classical-integral, symmetry, and gauge directions can be separated.
witness_requirements.W9: At least one nontrivial NVE block has rational or algebraic coefficients over the declared base field and is not the known obstruction-free homothetic equation.
witness_requirements.W10: The analyzed open curve avoids collision singularities, or an exact meromorphic regularization and physical pullback are proved.
witness_requirements.W11: A source-disjoint exact implementation reproduces the orbit equations, H=C=0, generic regularity, and NVE coefficient data.
witness_requirements.W12: Every derivation input and generated artifact has immutable provenance, and the independent reference imports no production implementation.

exact_equivalence_rules.energy_polynomial: Use P_E=2*x*(1-x)*E, the frozen v2 polynomial normalized-energy numerator. On x*(1-x)!=0, P_E=0 if and only if E=0.
exact_equivalence_rules.denominator_clearing: After exact substitution, use the primitive numerator over QQ. Removed powers of z and declared cover denominators are units on the frozen Laurent dense open.
exact_equivalence_rules.support_localization: Impose eta*product(all support coefficients)-1=0. Divide any coefficient equation by its greatest monomial factor in support coefficients before basis computation; the localized zero set is unchanged.
exact_equivalence_rules.canonicalization: Expand over QQ, take primitive sign-normalized polynomials, remove zero equations, and deduplicate by exact structural representation.
exact_equivalence_rules.stage_order: ENERGY, then ENERGY_AND_V only if needed, then FULL only if needed.
exact_equivalence_rules.unit_decision: Both exact grevlex F5B and exact grevlex Buchberger bases must equal [1].
exact_equivalence_rules.non_unit_decision: Both exact algorithms must return non-unit for FULL, followed by an exact lex basis and complete branch audit.
exact_equivalence_rules.disagreement: Any algorithm disagreement, timeout, exception, or missing branch representation is unresolved and forces INCOMPLETE.

required_outputs: exact-equivalence tests against the frozen v2 model
qualification lock, result, signed record, and human-readable report
adversarial_controls: Reject any changed cover, support, mass sentinel, coefficient field, residual identity, or enumeration order.
Reject stripping a factor not proved to be a unit on the frozen dense open.
Reject a unit decision not independently returned by both locked exact algorithms.
Reject u identically zero, constant-shape homothetic branches, massless degenerations, collision-only support, and numerical residuals.
Reject sentinel-only or special-mass candidates as satisfying W2.
Treat every timeout, resource abort, malformed ideal, algorithm disagreement, or unaudited non-unit branch as INCOMPLETE.
Reject opening WP6-DZ-MR-v1 from COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT or INCOMPLETE.

decision_policy.QUALIFIED_WITNESS: At least one frozen candidate passes W1-W12, every system through its discovery index is exactly dual-decided, and all integrity and adversarial controls pass.
decision_policy.COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT: All 11,700 locked ideals are exactly dual-decided, every non-unit ideal is completely represented and audited, no candidate passes W1-W12, and all controls pass.
decision_policy.INCOMPLETE: Any frozen input changes, any system is omitted or unresolved, either exact algorithm fails or disagrees, any non-unit ideal is unaudited, or any required control fails.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_NULL_CLAIM: Within the four frozen v2 shape covers, exact one- and two-term Laurent supports with exponents -2 through 2, and thirteen exact mass/order sentinels, the dual-exact v3 campaign found no graph that extends to a W1-W12 arbitrary-positive-mass witness.
decision_policy.MR_PROMOTION_RULE: Create WP6-DZ-MR-v1 only when the signed v3 record status is QUALIFIED_WITNESS and names exactly one frozen full-system witness. Every other status prohibits promotion.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_NONEXISTENCE_CLAIM: No explicit nonhomothetic algebraic H=C=0 orbit exists.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_NONINTEGRABILITY_CLAIM: The planar Newtonian three-body problem is nonintegrable on (H,C)=(0,0).
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_MR_CLAIM: A Morales-Ramis or Ziglin obstruction has been proved on the double-zero level.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_SCOPE_CLAIM: The search covers implicit algebraic curves, larger Laurent supports, other covers, or transcendental trajectories.

stop_rule.null_stop: Return COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT only after all 11,700 systems and every non-unit branch are exactly decided and audited.
stop_rule.no_scope_extension: Do not alter mathematical scope, solver algorithms, or resource caps after implementation starts. Any change requires WP6-DZ-FEAS-v4.

invalidation: V3 implementation or search output existed before the specification lock.
Any frozen v2 predecessor artifact changed.
A denominator or monomial factor was removed outside its declared localization.
A floating, probabilistic, single-algorithm, or interpolated result was treated as exact.
A timed-out system was omitted, selectively retried, or silently reclassified.
WP6-DZ-MR-v1 was created without the required signed success record.
